# OMP Plan Kit

> Standalone Oh My Pi (OMP) planning kit. The first release is a deterministic plan-handoff guard; future releases add plan structure, readability, plan-pomogator workflow, and OMP Spec Kit synchronization.

## Canonical facts

- Package: `omp-plan-kit`.
- Product: OMP Plan Kit for safe, readable, traceable AI coding plans.
- Current release: v1.7.0.
- Runtime entrypoint: `dist/extension.js` through `package.json#omp.extensions`.
- Current hard guard: programmer-only `tool_call` interception for `write` calls targeting `xd://propose`.
- Accepted proposal: one strict plan slug whose exact `local://<slug>-plan.md` artifact already exists.
- Invalid Markdown, empty, whitespace, traversal, or missing-artifact proposals are blocked before OMP dispatch with zero model calls.
- Valid slug/artifact proposals pass deterministic validation and continue to OMP native review and watchdog logic.
- Intermediate planning steps (todo, reads, scratch edits) do not call a plan-specific model.
- No plan-specific model call, model budget, or model verdict cache exists in this plugin.
- Manual proof: e2e handoff plus the deterministic validator and hook suites.
- No external proxy dependency. No `claude -p`. No transcript or full-plan upload.
- User install: omp plugin install github:stgmt/omp-plan-kit#v1.7.0.
- All current profiles: `node scripts/install-all-profiles.mjs`.
- Manual programmer proof: `npm run e2e:programmer`.
- Product roadmap: `ROADMAP.md`.
- Release review: audit-reports/omp-plan-kit-v1.7.0-review-2026-09-06.md.
- Origin incident: https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/10333.
- Reported impact: an older plan was accepted after a scope correction, costing roughly half of one week's Codex allowance on the maximum subscription tier.

## Future direction

The kit will synchronize plans with project OMP Spec Kit graphs: requirements, acceptance
criteria, decisions, research, tasks, scenarios, implementation files, and verification evidence.
The plan identity and spec identity remain distinct but linked.

## Installation

```bash
omp plugin install github:stgmt/omp-plan-kit#v1.1.0
```

## Safety boundary

- Deterministic validation and convergence checks run before native OMP review.
- This plugin does not call a plan-specific model, store model credentials, or upload full plans or transcripts.
- Native OMP owns any model-driven review after the plugin allows a valid proposal.

## Repository

GitHub: https://github.com/stgmt/omp-plan-kit
